question: Should Google realtime voice send all tool schemas through `FunctionDeclaration.parameters` now, or should custom schema normalization be required before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and supported by live proof, but the field switch affects every custom Google realtime voice tool schema and may change provider-side interpretation for existing users.

options.title: Accept focused field switch
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer signoff that honoring schemas on preview audio models is worth the bounded custom-schema compatibility risk.

options.title: Normalize custom schemas first
options.body: Require a schema-normalization layer before merge if maintainers want stronger upgrade safety for custom realtime tools.

options.title: Fold into broader schema hardening
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the broader Google schema-hardening work to own the realtime field decision.

recommendation.title: Accept focused field switch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer signoff that honoring schemas on preview audio models is worth the bounded custom-schema compatibility risk.
